Edit facts here only. tools/facts.py writes the Ask copy into js/agent-core.js (python3 tools/facts.py sync) and fails the build when that copy, the built /facts.json or any page disagrees with this file (python3 tools/facts.py gate <built site>). status 'approved': published everywhere, with its evidence. status 'held': kept off /facts.json, the Facts page, the structured data and Ask because AmIMotion's own sources word it differently; pages may keep only the wording listed under 'forms' until the founders confirm it. profile.name: AmIMotion supplier facts
profile.description: AmIMotion's published supplier facts for buyers and their AI assistants. Each fact has its wording, its qualifier in the same sentence, its source and the date it was last reviewed.
profile.how_to_use: Quote a fact with its qualifier. A topic that is not listed here is not claimed by AmIMotion. Datasheets, prices and pilot options are shared under NDA after a first call.

facts.label: Company
facts.claim: AmIMotion is a brand of Locatepro Technologies Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru, India.

facts.label: Contact
facts.claim: Sales contact: sales@amimotion.com.

facts.label: What it does
facts.claim: AmIMotion's category is Industrial Spatial Intelligence. Its commercial focus is WIP (work-in-progress) visibility in manufacturing, built on UWB real-time location (RTLS).

facts.label: Where it is made
facts.claim: Designed and built in India.

facts.label: Leadership
facts.claim: Kaushal Kukkar is founder and CEO. Vivek Dham is CTO.
facts.register: amber, the titles every source agrees on

facts.label: The system
facts.claim: A complete UWB real-time location system in three parts: AmIGo tags, AmIMo anchors and AmIHub software.

facts.label: Accuracy
facts.claim: ±10 cm positioning in 3D, typical, with AmIMo anchors. Accuracy depends on the site and is measured in a pilot.

facts.label: Radios
facts.claim: UWB, BLE and Wi-Fi FTM ranging on the same AmIMo anchors. Wi-Fi FTM device support is confirmed per site.

facts.label: Battery life
facts.claim: AmIGo tag battery life is 1 to 3 years, typical and usage-dependent.

facts.label: Cabling and power
facts.claim: AmIMo anchors need no data or sync cabling: Wi-Fi backhaul (Ethernet option) and power by DC adapter or PoE.

facts.label: Coverage
facts.claim: About 50 m line-of-sight coverage per AmIMo anchor, site-dependent; a site survey sets the final count.

facts.label: Where it runs
facts.claim: AmIHub runs on an industrial PC inside your plant, with no internet needed, or in the cloud.

facts.label: Interfaces
facts.claim: AmIHub interfaces: REST, MQTT, WebSocket and an omlox hub interface, to connect with MES, ERP, WMS, SCADA and BI. Specific connectors are confirmed per project.

facts.label: Latency and scale
facts.claim: Under a second from tag pulse to map, and thousands of tags per site; both indicative.

facts.label: AI assistants
facts.claim: AmIHub has a built-in MCP server, so AI assistants can query live location data. Any action needs a person's approval. This is a described capability, shown in a demo on request.

facts.label: Where a pilot starts
facts.claim: Pilots start in one bay or one line and scale on the same AmIHub.

facts.label: Demo
facts.claim: A live demo on real AmIHub data is available on a discovery call.

facts.label: How buying runs
facts.claim: Buying happens in four steps: a call with a live demo on real AmIHub data; the NDA pack with datasheets, architecture, prices and pilot options; a site survey and a pilot in one bay or line; then plant-wide on the same AmIHub.

facts.label: Prices
facts.claim: Prices are in the NDA pack, after the first call.

facts.label: What a pilot tags
facts.claim: A pilot tags trolleys, bins and pallets, not people. Tagging people would be a separate project with its own policy.

facts.label: Which job is on a carrier
facts.claim: Location alone does not show which job is on a carrier. You link each carrier to its job, in AmIHub or from your own system.

facts.label: Certification
facts.claim: AmIMotion claims no formal certification.

facts.label: Customers
facts.claim: This site names no customer and shows no customer result. References are shared under NDA.

facts.label: Standards
facts.claim: Built on the FiRa and omlox specifications.
facts.register: founders' wording (review of 29 Oct 2026), chosen by Shiv 22 Nov 2026 over the register's 'compliant'

facts.reason: AmIMotion's sources give different titles and years for the team. The homepage team section (locked, founders' version) keeps its wording; the profile lists only what every source agrees on.

facts.reason: Published in the brochure as indicative values with the final datasheet under NDA, but not in the claims register, so not in the machine profile. The specification pages keep them with their conditions.
